data.name: Qameelah
data.gender_notes: Qameelah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qameelah means 'perfect' or 'complete' in Arabic. It signifies someone who is whole and flawless. The name Qameelah carries the meaning “Perfect, Complete” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qameelah usually hope their child will grow to embody perfect, complete and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Qameelah relates to spiritual completeness and righteousness.
data.etymology: Qameelah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Perfect, Complete.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qameelah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: قميلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم قميلة مشتق من الجمال والحسن، و يعني الفتاة الجميلة أو الحسناء، و هو اسم ذو أصول عربية، و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني إيجابية و جميلة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: قمیلا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام قمیلا کا مطلب خوبصورت یا حسین ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا اہم مقام ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیاء میں جہاں اردو زبان بولی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कमीलाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: कमीलाह नाम का अर्थ सुंदर या अच्छी होता है, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका विशेष महत्व है, जहां यह नाम पारंपरिक और आधुनिक दोनों संदर्भों में प्रयोग होता है।

in_pashto.name: قميلہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: د قميلہ نوم مانع ښايسته يا پټۍ دي، دا نوم عربي ټوټې لري او په افغان او پښتني دود کې يې مهم ځای دی، په تېګه د ښځينو لپاره يو ښه او معنوي نوم ګڼل کېږي.

in_english.name: Qameelah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Qameelah is derived from Arabic roots, specifically meaning 'beautiful' or 'lovely'. It has a rich etymology linked to concepts of beauty and goodness. In Islamic tradition, names are chosen for their positive meanings and Qameelah is no exception, embodying desirable qualities for a person to aspire to. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the importance of beauty, both inner and outer, in Islamic values.
